headline: AEON's card portal and app were already down more than 40 hours by Nov 20 and came back on Nov 21.
summary: Correction: c002 and timeline row t002 said the 40-hour outage count was as of 2 PM on Nov 21 (HK time). Dimsum Daily's article published Nov 20 (s006) gives that count as of 2 PM on Nov 20; HK01's page was republished on Nov 22 and kept the earlier caption. Fixed both and added t004 for services coming back on Nov 21. Added Metro Radio (s007, Tier 2, Nov 21), which reports the notice and the Nov 21 restoration; added to c001 and c002, labels unchanged. AEON's notice is unchanged; no HKEX announcement (latest on AEON's investor page is Nov 16), no statement from the privacy commissioner's office, HKMA or police, no data types, count, cause or attacker. Other new reports (Commercial Radio, Bastille Post) repeat the notice. Staleness check done. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent

headline: AEON Credit says its system was accessed without authorization after its card portal and app were down for more than 40 hours.
summary: First draft. 5 sources (1 Tier 1, 3 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 9 claims, 5 questions. AEON's own website notice confirms unauthorized access; RTHK and The Standard report it independently. The company has not tied it to the outage or said what data was reached. No Hong Kong regulator statement found. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
